page.notes: The running head "Consequentiæ" is hard to read in the scan; the reading is doubtful. The note "Corv. conf." beside line "3.Corvin." is uncertain: the scan shows "Corv. com" or similar. The note beside "ideo dici" reads "Molina. c." followed by a numeral that may be "f. 10" or "s. 10"; the reading is doubtful. The final word is hyphenated across the last two lines as "in-" and "cipit." and is kept that way. The line "cipit." is part of the text, not a catchword.
